existingDispositions.rationale: Physical fatigue, occupied processing and group participation are distinct; NIMH frameworks do not identify the PRC-085 segment.
Reuse BIO-F01 B04 revision-review-only finding: distinguish perceived load, available resources and performance under load. Psychological consultation adds no replacement.
Ambient noise effects depend on speech/intermittency/task and performance measure; IPCC health chapter is not an exact noise→load trial.
Content emotional intensity and recipient salience are separate; misinformation synthesis and dehumanization/violence sources do not establish this exact edge.
Reuse INF-F03 approved revision-proposal-only finding: ambiguity and cognitive-processing demand require task/proxy alignment; no replacement implemented.
Occupied resources and available resources can be complementary descriptions under a fixed-capacity model; that does not establish independent temporal causation.
Retain bounded ENABLES interpretation: available resources permit, but do not compel, issue-relevant integration.
Need for cognition is a disposition and effortful processing is a state; scale validation and theory alone do not identify within-person causal change.
Preserve existing ease-attribution, exposure, expectation and stimulus qualifications; fluency and familiarity remain distinct.
Preserve existing attribution/expectation/feedback/domain scope; experienced ease can inform confidence without establishing accuracy.
Attention-control capacity and WM availability are related but cannot be equated with task performance; CONSTRAINS plus POSITIVE requires explicit protective-capacity interpretation.
One person's load does not automatically determine SMALL_GROUP communication participation equality; PRC-085 label is not pathway evidence.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Cognitive load is simply task difficulty.
gapQuestions.rationale: Demand, expertise and experienced/occupied resources differ.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Adding instructional cues decreases PSY-057.
gapQuestions.rationale: Meta-analysis pools effort and difficulty scales; EA-0010 preserves proxy gap.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Instructional visual cues increase PSY-055 target-allocation proportion.
gapQuestions.rationale: Fixation duration/count and first fixation differ from normalized allocation; no exact scoped proportion contrast extracted.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Learning gain proves attention→load→learning mediation.
gapQuestions.rationale: Meta-regression across studies is not pathway-specific causal mediation.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: N-back practice increases general PSY-058 availability.
gapQuestions.rationale: EA-0011 remains UNKNOWN; practiced/untrained n-back gain differs from broader resources.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Higher n-back accuracy is working-memory availability by definition.
gapQuestions.rationale: Score is a task-dependent indicator, not the construct.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Mindfulness changes PSY-062 across tasks.
gapQuestions.rationale: Active-comparator, accuracy/latency and clinical sampling differences; no single reusable operation or exact transferable capacity identified.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Psychological acceptance flexibility equals cognitive flexibility.
gapQuestions.rationale: Acceptance and perspective/rule switching are different constructs.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Disfluent font reliably increases PSY-059 elaboration.
gapQuestions.rationale: Meyer replication pool found no CRT solution advantage; original heuristic results do not establish exact issue-relevant processing.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Longer response times demonstrate deeper elaboration.
gapQuestions.rationale: Slowness can be decoding difficulty, distraction or strategy.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Processing fluency equals familiarity or confidence.
gapQuestions.rationale: Ease is information interpreted in context, not either judgment.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Perceived exclusion changes selective attention to acceptance cues.
gapQuestions.rationale: Threat, Cyberball and gaze designs differ; no uniform exclusion effect; reuse existing identity only when operation matches.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Social inclusion and exclusion are one opposite signed attention effect.
gapQuestions.rationale: A non-social control can separate inclusion effects from exclusion nondetection.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Culture relates to object/context attention allocation.
gapQuestions.rationale: Country group is not an exact CUL Driver; sampling, language and viewing context confounded. No new ontology entity.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Financial scarcity cues reduce available WM.
gapQuestions.rationale: Task performance is not PSY-058; small/uncertain effects and limited designs in cue meta-analysis; subjective scarcity not income itself.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A prime makes the ConstrualFrame LEVEL increase.
gapQuestions.rationale: PSY-060 is nominal categorical, with no common ordinal increase across frames.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Qualified PSY-060 frame changes from a named baseline category to another.
gapQuestions.rationale: External wording/choice is not proof of internal category transition; exact validated state qualifier and timing needed.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Sleep duration changes load rather than performance.
gapQuestions.rationale: Protected BIO-F01 B04 already owns exact alternatives; no new proposal or prior-pilot repair.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Ambient noise changes load.
gapQuestions.rationale: Existing ENV-045 review only; speech/task and comparator need exact alignment.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Physical fatigue→load→participation equality is a transmitted pathway.
gapQuestions.rationale: PRC-085 reachability and NIMH framework references lack pathway-specific evidence and unit alignment.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Need for cognition modifies REL-PSY-029.
gapQuestions.rationale: Exact capacity×disposition interaction under an aligned message/task not extracted; no substitute trait→outcome edge.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Prior knowledge modifies the instructional cue effect.
gapQuestions.rationale: Schneider meta-analysis did not identify prior knowledge as moderator; between-study comparisons not an exact governed causal-edge interaction.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Load and availability are automatically two independent causal contributions.
gapQuestions.rationale: Complementary resource descriptions can double represent one contribution; independence needs evidence.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Cognitive load transforms into stress.
gapQuestions.rationale: Separate constructs do not become each other; existing causal claim remains independently research-needed.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Emotionally intense content causes salience.
gapQuestions.rationale: Content, relevance, valence and psychological prominence must be separated; preserve external ownership.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Network position or screen opportunity directly sets attention.
gapQuestions.rationale: Opportunity/observed gaze/state delta is not subjective allocation or empirical consequence evidence.
